evaluation_scope: Score the final raw v5 object, typed C1E policy outcome, and deterministic resolver outcome as separate layers for each frozen case. Mapping and typed-label metrics never infer equivalence from a coincidentally matching ticker.
invalid_output_rule: Every frozen case remains in all-case and expected-class denominators. A missing or schema-invalid final output is incorrect for mapping, typed, policy, and completeness metrics and is excluded only from denominators explicitly conditioned on an observed valid role or accepted policy input.
issuer_comparison_rule: Compare issuer identities with event-asset-resolution-v1 deterministic CanonicalizeIssuerName normalization; compare exact normalized sets and exact causal roles, never fuzzy names.
candidate_comparison_rule: Compare principal proxy candidates as exact normalized bounded-exposure sets, including meaningful empty, singleton, and multiple-candidate cardinality; ticker equality is irrelevant.
legacy_denominator_rule: Historical v4, C1D, and C1D2 denominators are not reused. Every metric below has its own frozen C1E3 denominator.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose expected mapping is DIRECT and whose observed mapping is DIRECT with the exact normalized expected direct issuer.
metrics.denominator: All frozen cases whose expected mapping is DIRECT.

metrics.numerator: Observed DIRECT cases with expected DIRECT and the exact normalized expected direct issuer.
metrics.denominator: All cases with an observed valid DIRECT mapping; a schema-invalid final output is not an observed DIRECT.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose expected mapping is PROXY and whose observed mapping is PROXY with the exact expected bounded exposure.
metrics.denominator: All frozen cases whose expected mapping is PROXY.

metrics.numerator: Observed PROXY cases with expected PROXY and the exact expected bounded exposure.
metrics.denominator: All cases with an observed valid PROXY mapping; a schema-invalid final output is not an observed PROXY.

metrics.numerator: Expected UNRESOLVED cases whose observed valid mapping is UNRESOLVED.
metrics.denominator: All frozen cases whose expected mapping is UNRESOLVED.

metrics.numerator: Count of observed valid DIRECT cases that are not an exact expected DIRECT mapping, including wrong issuer.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases for the companion false-DIRECT rate; retain the numerator as an absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Count of observed valid PROXY cases that are not an exact expected PROXY mapping, including wrong exposure.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases for the companion false-PROXY rate; retain the numerator as an absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Cases with exact equality of the complete normalized issuer-to-role set and exact principal-proxy-candidate set.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; invalid final outputs are incorrect.

metrics.numerator: Cases where the observed normalized PRINCIPAL issuer set exactly equals the expected PRINCIPAL issuer set.
metrics.denominator: Cases where either expected or observed valid attribution contains PRINCIPAL; invalid output on an expected PRINCIPAL case remains in the denominator.

metrics.numerator: Cases where the observed normalized EQUAL_PRINCIPAL issuer set exactly equals the expected EQUAL_PRINCIPAL set, including cardinality.
metrics.denominator: Cases where either expected or observed valid attribution contains EQUAL_PRINCIPAL; invalid output on an expected EQUAL_PRINCIPAL case remains in the denominator.

metrics.numerator: Cases where the observed normalized SECONDARY_AFFECTED issuer set exactly equals the expected SECONDARY_AFFECTED set.
metrics.denominator: Cases where either expected or observed valid attribution contains SECONDARY_AFFECTED; invalid output on an expected SECONDARY_AFFECTED case remains in the denominator.

metrics.numerator: Cases where the observed normalized CONTEXT_ONLY issuer set exactly equals the expected CONTEXT_ONLY set.
metrics.denominator: Cases where either expected or observed valid attribution contains CONTEXT_ONLY; invalid output on an expected CONTEXT_ONLY case remains in the denominator.

metrics.numerator: Cases where the observed normalized POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL issuer set exactly equals the expected POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL set.
metrics.denominator: Cases where either expected or observed valid attribution contains POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL; invalid output on an expected POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL case remains in the denominator.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed normalized principal-proxy-candidate set exactly equals the expected set.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases, including cases whose expected set is empty.

metrics.numerator: Cases containing every expected normalized issuer-role pair and every expected principal proxy candidate; extra entries do not repair an omission and are penalized by whole-case correctness.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; invalid final outputs are incomplete.

metrics.numerator: Cases where policy acceptance versus abstention and, when accepted, the effective semantic mapping exactly match the mapping implied by the frozen typed label.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; invalid final outputs are incorrect.

metrics.numerator: Expected UNRESOLVED cases for which the typed policy abstains with the reason class implied by equal principals, possible principals, no candidate, or multiple proxy candidates.
metrics.denominator: All frozen cases whose expected mapping is UNRESOLVED.

metrics.numerator: Count of cases with an observed raw exact selectable DIRECT or PROXY mapping that the typed policy changes to UNRESOLVED.
metrics.denominator: All cases with an observed raw exact selectable DIRECT or PROXY mapping; retain the numerator as an absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Count of expected UNRESOLVED cases for which the typed policy accepts DIRECT or PROXY.
metrics.denominator: All frozen cases whose expected mapping is UNRESOLVED; retain the numerator as an absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Cases with a semantically correct policy-accepted DIRECT or PROXY whose resolver status exactly equals the frozen expected deterministic status and whose resolved semantic rule is the expected issuer or exposure rule.
metrics.denominator: Cases with a semantically correct policy-accepted DIRECT or PROXY; policy-abstained and semantically wrong inputs are excluded.

metrics.numerator: Semantically correct policy-accepted DIRECT or PROXY cases expected to resolve ambiguous or unresolved whose observed resolver status exactly matches that expected non-resolved status.
metrics.denominator: Semantically correct policy-accepted DIRECT or PROXY cases whose frozen expected deterministic status is ambiguous or unresolved.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed valid attribution contains at least one POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; also report the numerator as an absolute case count.

metrics.numerator: Observed POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL cases whose exact normalized possible-principal set equals the expected set.
metrics.denominator: All cases whose observed valid attribution contains POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL.

metrics.numerator: Observed POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL cases whose exact normalized possible-principal set does not equal the expected set.
metrics.denominator: All cases whose observed valid attribution contains POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose typed policy abstains with POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL_ISSUER.
metrics.denominator: All cases whose observed valid attribution contains POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL; also report the numerator as an absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Expected selectable DIRECT or PROXY cases incorrectly marked with POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL and consequently abstained by policy.
metrics.denominator: All frozen cases whose expected mapping is DIRECT or PROXY; also report the numerator as an absolute count.
